# Pandatech MassTransit Outbox

> Outbox and inbox pattern implementation for MassTransit with multiple DbContext support. Two independent NuGet packages: PostgreSQL-specific (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) and provider-agnostic EF Core (lease-based concurrency).

This library solves a limitation of MassTransit's built-in transactional outbox, which only supports a single DbContext. These packages let you reliably publish and consume messages across many modules, each with its own DbContext — designed for modular monolith and microservice architectures.

- Packages: `Pandatech.MassTransit.PostgresOutbox`, `Pandatech.MassTransit.EfCoreOutbox`
- License: MIT
- Targets: net9.0, net10.0
- Dependencies: MassTransit, EF Core

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/README.md): Full usage guide, quick start, settings reference, architecture explanation

## Source — PostgresOutbox

- [InboxConsumer](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.PostgresOutbox/Abstractions/InboxConsumer.cs): Base consumer with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and database-backed retry
- [OutboxMessagePublisherService](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.PostgresOutbox/Jobs/OutboxMessagePublisherService.cs): Background service that polls and publishes outbox messages
- [InboxMessageRetryService](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.PostgresOutbox/Jobs/InboxMessageRetryService.cs): Background service that re-dispatches failed inbox messages
- [ServiceCollectionExtensions](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.PostgresOutbox/Extensions/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs): DI registration methods
- [Settings](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.PostgresOutbox/Settings.cs): Configuration for all background services

## Source — EfCoreOutbox

- [InboxConsumer](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.EfCoreOutbox/Abstractions/InboxConsumer.cs): Base consumer with lease-based concurrency, lease theft detection, and database-backed retry
- [OutboxMessagePublisherService](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.EfCoreOutbox/Jobs/OutboxMessagePublisherService.cs): Background service with lease-acquire-verify-publish pattern
- [InboxMessageRetryService](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.EfCoreOutbox/Jobs/InboxMessageRetryService.cs): Background service that re-dispatches failed inbox messages with lease-aware filtering
- [ServiceCollectionExtensions](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.EfCoreOutbox/Extensions/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs): DI registration methods
- [Settings](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.EfCoreOutbox/Settings.cs): Configuration including LeaseDuration for the lease-based strategy

## Optional

- [OutboxDbContextExtensions](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.PostgresOutbox/Extensions/OutboxDbContextExtensions.cs): AddToOutbox / AddToOutboxRange helper methods
- [ModelBuilderExtensions](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.PostgresOutbox/Extensions/ModelBuilderExtensions.cs): EF Core entity configuration
- [OutboxMessage](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.PostgresOutbox/Entities/OutboxMessage.cs): Outbox entity definition
- [InboxMessage](https://github.com/PandaTechAM/be-lib-masstransit-outbox/blob/main/src/MassTransit.PostgresOutbox/Entities/InboxMessage.cs): Inbox entity with retry fields
